observation: Source camera selection also applied drawing-only include lists and reset the pivot without fitting. A legacy size-display exception made the size checkbox ineffective for unregistered subjects; selecting assemblies mixed their sizes with descendants.
cause: Camera pose, geometry inclusion, annotation eligibility and framing were coupled. Size visibility depended on whether relationship records existed rather than on the explicit display switch.
proposed_rule: Keep geometry visibility, source annotation eligibility and framing independent. A model camera must not inherit a drawing's component exclusion list. Distinguish deliberate source-view center/fit from pose-only shortcuts according to the owner's confirmed interaction choice. A size switch controls all size overlays consistently, including size-only projects; selected assemblies show their own recorded overall sizes, not descendants or invented measurements. Display selection identity and explain off, empty, hidden and edge-on results. Preserve source-filtered checking representations separately.
limits: Source camera centering/fitting and assembly-own size defaults are confirmed owner preferences, not universal CAD conventions. Supersedes the overly broad preserve-scale-for-all-presets wording; earlier lessons remain unchanged. Complete-model inclusion does not imply every object is unoccluded. Mobile verification is viewport emulation only. No source reconstruction, manufacturer sizing, fabrication approval or frozen-version update. Project mappings and values remain local.
